name: Akia Web Chat
author: travisakia

sections.description:
Akia Web Chat is a WordPress plugin that enables intelligent chat functionality on your website through the Akia service. This plugin acts as an interface to connect your WordPress site with Akia’s conversational AI platform, designed specifically for the hospitality industry.

Key Features:

  • Easy integration with Akia’s chat service
  • Simple configuration through WordPress admin settings
  • Automatic chat widget loading on your website
  • Admin notifications to help you configure the plugin
  • Simple “Configure Akia” setup flow

External Services

This plugin connects to Akia’s external service to provide chat functionality on your website. The chat service is required for the plugin to function and is used to display the interactive chat widget to your website visitors.

What the service is and what it is used for:

This plugin connects to Akia’s chat service (https://sys.akia.ai/) to provide an interactive chat widget on your website. The service enables real-time chat conversations between your website visitors and Akia’s conversational AI platform.

What data is sent and when:

  1. During plugin configuration (admin only):

    • Your website’s origin (domain) is sent to https://sys.akia.ai/website_chat_token_exchange to establish a secure connection and obtain an authentication token. This happens only when you complete the “Configure Akia” setup flow in the WordPress admin panel.

  2. On your website’s frontend (when chat is enabled):

    • The authentication token (stored securely in WordPress options) is included in the URL when loading the chat JavaScript from https://sys.akia.ai/website_chat_js/{token}/chat.js. This script is loaded on every page view when a valid token is configured.
    • The chat JavaScript itself may collect and send visitor data (such as chat messages, page URLs, and other interaction data) to Akia’s servers. Please refer to Akia’s Privacy Policy for details on what data is collected by the chat service.

Service Information:

This service is provided by Akia:
* Terms of Service: https://mkt.akia.com/akia-terms-and-conditions
* Privacy Policy: https://www.akia.com/privacy

To use this plugin, you will need:
1. An active Akia account
2. Complete the “Configure Akia” flow in the plugin settings

The plugin is free to use, but the Akia service itself may have its own pricing and terms. Please refer to Akia’s website for service details, pricing, and terms of use. For questions about terms and conditions, please contact Akia directly.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Akia Web Chat in your WordPress admin panel.
  4. Complete the “Configure Akia” flow to connect your Akia account.
  5. The chat widget will automatically appear on your website once configured.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Akia account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active Akia account to use this plugin. The plugin connects to Akia’s service to provide chat functionality.

How do I configure Akia?

Use the “Configure Akia” flow in the plugin settings (Settings > Akia Web Chat) to connect your Akia account. This guided setup process will walk you through connecting your account.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin itself is free and open source. However, the Akia service may have its own pricing and terms. Please check with Akia for service pricing information.

Does this plugin track my website visitors?

The plugin loads JavaScript from Akia’s servers. Please review Akia’s Privacy Policy to understand how they handle user data and tracking.

Can I customize the chat widget appearance?

Chat widget customization is typically handled through your Akia dashboard settings, not through this WordPress plugin.
